这原本是我为我的模组RandomStars制作的附属模组，但是我将它独立了出来供大家使用
Originally developed as an add-on for my RandomStars mod, I've now released it as a standalone mod for everyone to use
《星露谷武器品质成长模组》—— 赋予你的武器无限可能！厌倦了频繁更换武器？渴望与伙伴并肩作战的成长感？
这款模组为你的武器注入灵魂，赋予其品质与成长之路，让每一把武器都能焕发光明未来！
核心机制：六阶品质，阶梯式成长：从低到高分为**破损（Broken）→ 普通（Common）→ 稀有（Rare）→ 史诗（Epic）→ 传说（Legendary）→ 起源（Origin）**共6个品质。
基础伤害倍率逐级提升：0.7倍 → 1.0倍 → 1.1倍 → 1.2倍 → 1.3倍 → 1.5倍，品质决定下限，成长决定上限！
概率获取，策略选择：物品获取时随机赋予品质（概率固定）：破损（10%） | 普通（58%） | 稀有（16%） | 史诗（10%） | 传说（5%） | 起源（1%）高稀有度意味着更高起点，但低品质武器也能通过成长逆袭！
专属等级，经验共进：不同品质拥有独立成长上限：破损（15级）→ 普通（20级）→ 稀有（25级）→ 史诗（30级）→ 传说（35级）→ 起源（50级）。
武器通过战斗获取经验（仅手持武器有效），与玩家共同成长！
升级即变强：每升1小级：随机提升攻击、暴击、攻速等属性（属性池随品质扩展）。每达5级整数倍（如5级、10级、15级...）：获得固定强力属性加成（如额外技能、特殊特效）。
羁绊与养成：武器不再是消耗品！从微弱的“破损”到神级的“起源”，见证它与你从弱小到巅峰的蜕变，每一场战斗都是你们的共同回忆。

[b]"Stardew Valley Weapon Quality & Progression Mod" — Empower Your Weapons with Limitless Potential![/b]
Tired of constantly replacing weapons? Craving a sense of growth alongside your companions in battle? This mod breathes life into your weapons, granting them tiers of quality and a path to greatness, ensuring each one has a shining future!
[b]Core Mechanics:[/b]
1. 
[b]Six Tiers of Quality, Ascending Power:[/b]
● 
Weapons progress through [b]Broken → Common → Rare → Epic → Legendary → Origin[/b], 6 escalating tiers.
● 
Base Damage Multipliers scale up: [b]0.7x → 1.0x → 1.1x → 1.2x → 1.3x → 1.5x[/b]. Quality sets the baseline; progression unlocks true might!
2. 
[b]Randomized Acquisition, Strategic Choices:[/b]
● 
Items spawn with fixed chances per tier:
○ 
[b]Broken (10%)[/b] | [b]Common (58%)[/b] | [b]Rare (16%)[/b] | [b]Epic (10%)[/b] | [b]Legendary (5%)[/b] | [b]Origin (1%)[/b]
● 
Higher tiers grant a head start, but lower-tier weapons can catch up through grinding!
3. 
[b]Tiered Levels, Shared Combat Experience:[/b]
● 
Each tier has a unique [b]Level Cap[/b]: [b]Broken (L15)[/b] → [b]Common (L20)[/b] → [b]Rare (L25)[/b] → [b]Epic (L30)[/b] → [b]Legendary (L35)[/b] → [b]Origin (L50)[/b].
● 
Weapons gain [b]Combat Experience[/b] in battle ([b]only while equipped[/b]), leveling up alongside you!
● 
[b]Level Up Bonuses:[/b]
○ 
[b]Every Small Level Up[/b]: [b]Random stat boosts[/b] (Attack, Crit, Speed, etc.) from a growing pool based on tier.
○ 
[b]Every 5th Level[/b] (5, 10, 15...): [b]Major Power-Up[/b] with fixed, game-changing bonuses (extra skills, unique effects).
4. 
[b]Bonding & Cultivation:[/b]
● 
No more disposable weapons! Witness your [b]Broken[/b] relic evolve into an [b]Origin[/b] god-weapon, a testament to your shared journey from weakness to dominance. Every battle forges memories!

[/list]V1.0.6 Update Notes:
Added Starry Anvil & Starry Furnace: Ported from another mod to enrich our gameplay!
Starry Anvil: Allows you to upgrade weapon quality by consuming the corresponding Weapon Crystals and Multicolored Fragments. Simply hover your mouse over the button to check the exact requirements and success rate.
Starry Furnace: Used for smelting weapons. Just place a weapon inside and close the UI. It will consume Fire Crystals as fuel to begin smelting. Different weapon qualities will yield different amounts of Weapon Crystals, which can be used to upgrade weapons at the Anvil. Note: Weapon Crystals are strictly type-specific and cannot be used to upgrade other types of weapons.
Traits Perfected: All traits have been fully polished and optimized, making their visual effects absolutely stunning!
